title: Transmission Control System (MIL Request)
shortDescription: Transmission control module is requesting MIL illumination.
fullDescription:
P0700 is set by the engine ECM when the TCM has detected one or more transmission DTCs and requested the malfunction indicator lamp.

It is not a diagnosis on its own — query the TCM for the underlying transmission codes.
safetyImpact: Indicates transmission fault; possible limp mode.

fixSteps.title: Scan all modules
fixSteps.instruction: Pull DTCs from ECM and TCM.

fixSteps.title: Check transmission fluid
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect fluid level, color, and smell.

fixSteps.title: Inspect wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Check transmission harness connector for corrosion.

fixSteps.title: Replace component
fixSteps.instruction: Replace solenoid, sensor, or service transmission as indicated.

faq.q: Can I drive with a transmission code?
faq.a: Limit driving — transmission damage compounds quickly. Tow if shifting is severely affected.
